name: CapCut
free_plan_limits: Free templates and basic editing tools; no numbers given
usage_note: 1,200 AI credits a month on Pro
since_note: Initial release May 2019 (Wikipedia); the English-language CapCut name and global launch came in 2020.
best_for: Quick short-form edits on phone or PC
notes: Teams plan is about $12.49 per seat for 2 seats; final price needs sign-in. Clips and text editing are not stated on the pricing page.

name: Adobe Premiere Pro
since_note: Premiere Pro launched September 2003 (Wikipedia); the original Premiere dates to 1991.
notes: Subscription only. Plans page lists 25 generative credits a month. Teams license is $37.99 per license. Captions and text editing not stated on this page.

name: Opus Clip
free_plan_limits: 1080p exports, 3-day export and storage, watermarked captions
since_note: Company founded 2022 by Young Zhao, Grace Wang and Jay Wu (tool profile).
notes: Text and timeline editing starts on Starter. Pro is $29 with a team workspace and API. Credit or minute limits are not stated on the page.

name: Descript
best_for: Editing video by editing the transcript
notes: Page does not label monthly vs annual; higher figures ($24 Hobbyist, $35 Creator) are read as monthly billing, annual is $16 and $24. Create Clips is on paid plans.

name: DaVinci Resolve
free_plan_limits: Full free version; up to 60fps 8-bit, Ultra HD
since_note: Initial release 2004 by da Vinci Systems; Blackmagic Design took over in 2009 (Wikipedia).
notes: Text-based editing is listed as a Studio feature. Auto captions are not clearly stated; subtitles are listed on the Edit page. Priced the free version.

name: Submagic
free_plan_limits: No free plan; free signup with no card, terms not described
usage_note: 45 credits (about 15 videos) a month on Starter
since_note: First Product Hunt launch 3 July 2023 (Product Hunt); directories list founded 2023.
notes: Yearly billing is $12 a month on Starter. Starter videos max 2 minutes. Page is inconsistent on some Pro limits. Magic Clips is only named under the custom plan.

name: Clipchamp
free_plan_limits: Unlimited exports at 1080p, no watermark, free stock only
since_note: Started as a startup in Brisbane in 2013; Microsoft acquired it in 2021 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Free simple editing on Windows or web
notes: Premium (4K, brand kit) comes with Microsoft 365 Personal or Family; dollar price not stated on the page. Priced the free editor.

name: Gling
free_plan_limits: 1 hour of AI-edited media a month, watermarked exports
usage_note: 10 hours of media a month on Plus
since_note: Launched on Product Hunt 14 August 2023 (Product Hunt).
notes: Yearly billing halves the price ($10 Plus). Same features on every plan. Page contradicts itself on XML export for the free plan.

name: VEED
notes: Not stated: the fetched pricing page showed no prices. Search snippets disagreed ($12 to $19 Lite). Billed per seat with monthly AI credits; subtitles have a 50 hours a month fair-use cap.

name: Riverside
since_note: Launched March 2020 (Calcalist); Riverside's own about page says 2019.
notes: The fetched page was flagged as a staging copy; confirm live. Yearly is $24 a month. Mac app listed; Windows not mentioned. Magic Clips are on Free.

name: AutoCut
free_plan_limits: No free plan; 14-day free trial, no card
notes: Plugin for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, so you need one of those. Basic ($79 a year) is silence removal only. AI Plan is $178.80 billed yearly.

name: Instagram Edits
free_plan_limits: Whole app is free; videos up to 10 minutes
since_note: Released April 2025 (news reports; Apple App Store listing).
notes: Phone app only (iPhone and Android); needs an Instagram login. Facts come from news reports and the App Store listing, not an Instagram pricing page. Premium features may come later.
